meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 上的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚合并一批改动,想快速录一段讲解给团队或用户看。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a video that explains the code change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just merged changes and want a quick explainer video for your team or users.

howto.what: 把 GitHub PR（代码改动）变成代码变更解说视频：读取 diff、commit 和文件，生成分镜、脚本、配音与逐帧画面，最终渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或在已检出仓库里说“this PR”时触发。意图不明或只是“做个视频”，会先走 /hyperframes 判定路线。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request (a code change) into a code-change explainer video: it reads the diff, commits and files, drafts a storyboard and script, generates narration and frame-by-frame scenes, and renders renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR link, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. Unclear intent, or a bare "make a video", first routes through /hyperframes.
